titles.title: Untitled (Abstraction Green Line and Red Circle)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Watercolor on white/cream colored paper. Abstraction Green Line and Red Circle.  Horizontal line with inward curve with red circle above it.  Red circle like a sun eclipse. This artwork has *Untitled (Abstraction Two Green Lines Small Red Circle)*, 1979 (cat. no. 1642) on the back.
